title: AI That Builds Dozens of Sites at Once
description:
Comment "OMMA" and I'll send you the link 👇

AI can now build dozens of landing pages at the same time. Omma runs AI agents in parallel on one infinite canvas. Type "make 50 apps" and they all appear at once. Say "make 10 variations of this" and they spin up side by side. Real editable HTML and CSS, live on your own domain in one click. Free plan, 50 credits a month.
